description: Search Finnish companies from the PRH trade register by name (current and former names), town or city, company form, industry code (TOL 2008) and postcode. Give at least one filter. Up to 100 hits per page. Costs 0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Base). Errors are free.

company_form.description: Company form code, e.g. OY, OYJ, KY, OK, SÄÄ.

industry.description: TOL 2008 industry code or prefix, e.g. 62 or 62010.

municipality.description: Town or city name, e.g. Helsinki.

name: search_finnish_companies
title: Search Finnish companies
